effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (SR05-EN012, Structure Deck: Wave of Light)

changes.historical_text: All non-Fairy-Type monsters lose 500 ATK and DEF. The activation and effects of Spell/Trap Cards you control cannot be negated.
changes.modern_text: All non-Fairy monsters lose 500 ATK/DEF. The activation and effects of Spell/Trap Cards activated on your field cannot be negated.
changes.summary: Functional erratum: the protection narrowed from Spell/Trap Cards you control to Spell/Trap Cards activated on your field. The pre-errata script registers an extra EFFECT_CANNOT_DISABLE field effect over your whole Spell/Trap side (TargetRange(LOCATION_ONFIELD,0), EFFECT_FLAG_SET_AVAILABLE so Set cards are covered too), which the modern script does not have at all; and its effectfilter for EFFECT_CANNOT_INACTIVATE/EFFECT_CANNOT_DISEFFECT accepts any Spell/Trap-type effect whose activating player is you, while the modern filter additionally requires the triggering location to include LOCATION_ONFIELD, so effects you activate from outside the field are no longer covered.

review.notes: Chain starts at lineage v1 (BP02-EN070, 2013-06-28). v0 (TDGS-EN094, 2008-09-02) -> v1 is wording only ('the activation and effects of your Spell and Trap Cards' -> 'of Spell/Trap Cards you control'), so it precedes the baseline and is not recorded; v0 is the printing in force at the Edison snapshot and is behaviourally the same as v1, and the erratum is dated 2018, nearly eight years after that snapshot. The baseline's cdb text reproduces v1's second sentence verbatim and paraphrases the first ('All monsters, except Fairy-Type monsters, lose 500 ATK/DEF' against 'All non-Fairy-Type monsters lose 500 ATK and DEF'), ratio 0.92; the pin to v1 rests on the second sentence, which is the one the erratum rewrote. Full scripts were read (pre-errata/c511003054.lua vs official/c5645210.lua) to confirm both elements above; the ATK/DEF debuff is identical in both.
